shared_elements: low-relief single rectangular panel dominated by one figure
justification: Both depict a single richly adorned human figure in strict profile with a tall headdress and beaded neck ornament filling a rectangular relief panel, which is the main correspondence. But A shows a full standing figure interacting with a smaller attendant figure and is framed by dense columns of written sign-blocks, while B is a close bust with a curled, tightly patterned beard and hair and no accompanying figures or signs; the rendering conventions (dense angular ornament versus smoothly modelled naturalistic flesh) also differ.
